summary: Oaktree Strategic Credit Fund filed an 8-K reporting a routine monthly distribution declaration and NAV update. The Board declared a regular cash distribution of $0.1600 per share across share classes, payable September 28, 2026, to record holders as of August 27, 2026. NAV per share as of July 31, 2026 was $22.30, down from $22.32. The fund disclosed aggregate NAV of $4.3 billion, portfolio fair value of $6.8 billion, and net leverage of 0.59x. This is a standard periodic disclosure, not a special situation.
